name: Submission
description: You attempt a forceful grapple on a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil. On a hit, you grapple the target. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. On your subsequent turns, while you are grappling a creature with this move, you can activate it again as a bonus action, with an automatic hit, dealing 2d6 {type} damage, taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil.
